title: READMEs, API documentation and changelogs that explain authentication
summary: Twenty Markdown documents that describe how to authenticate: copy .env.example, send Authorization: Bearer <token>, with placeholders and no credential.
rationale: Documentation talks about credentials constantly and is scanned with the rest of the repository. The vocabulary (API key, Bearer, token) is credential-shaped; the content is placeholders.
unscopedReason: Authored detector and arrival-target metadata intentionally assign no credential family; this fixture remains a global benchmark control.

expectation.rationale: Not flagged. Every example value is a placeholder or a description of a header.

externalRefs.note: legacy suite real-world-shapes; group realworld-docs; 20 fixtures
